verdict.rationale: GitLab documents reference architectures and scaling guidance ('Scale your GitLab installation by using the recommended configurations') plus supporting deployment options (Helm chart/Operator, Docker images, Linux package) that underpin large-scale self-hosted setups. However, there is no explicit mention of specific reference architecture tiers (e.g., 10k/25k/50k users) or benchmarks, and community evidence highlights real operational reliability issues (downtime, failed backups, performance problems) that raise doubts about smooth scaling in practice. Missing for 10: explicit named reference-architecture tiers for tens of thousands of users, third-party validation of scaling at that size, and resolution of community-reported reliability/performance concerns at scale.
